title: About SPEDICS
intro: SPEDICS provides professionally structured training designed to develop practical knowledge, confidence and career-ready skills.

welcomeNote.title: Welcome to SPEDICS
welcomeNote.heading: Empowering Educators. Enriching Childhood.
welcomeNote.text: SPEDICS Institute of Skill Development offers structured, practical and career-oriented teacher training and skill development programmes in Chennai. Whether you are a graduate, working teacher, homemaker or career changer — we help you build confidence and classroom-ready skills through online, offline and hybrid learning.

whoWeAre.title: Who We Are
whoWeAre.text: We are a Chennai-based institute focused on education and child development training. Our programmes combine structured curriculum, hands-on practice, trainer guidance and recognised certification — designed so learners can apply what they learn in real preschools, schools and education settings.

founderMessage.title: Message from the Founder
founderMessage.name: SPEDICS Leadership
founderMessage.text: Every child deserves a confident, skilled educator. At SPEDICS we believe training should be practical, accessible and rooted in real classroom experience. Our mission is to guide you from your first enquiry to a meaningful career in education — with flexible modes, transparent fees and ongoing support throughout your journey.

vision.title: Vision
vision.text: To empower educators and learners with practical skills to create better learning experiences and stronger futures.

mission.title: Mission
mission.text: To provide quality, practical and child-centred training that builds confident and competent professionals.

whyChoose.title: Structured Curriculum
whyChoose.text: Well-organised modules designed for progressive learning.

whyChoose.title: Practical Learning
whyChoose.text: Hands-on activities, demonstrations and real classroom strategies.

whyChoose.title: Online & Offline
whyChoose.text: Flexible modes to suit working professionals and homemakers.

whyChoose.title: Assessments
whyChoose.text: Assignments and evaluations to track your progress.

whyChoose.title: Trainer Guidance
whyChoose.text: Experienced mentors supporting you throughout the journey.

montessori.title: Why Montessori?
montessori.intro: Montessori education encourages independence, hands-on learning and respect for each child's individual development.
